What's included

Ask it anything
Find leads, skip trace an owner, run an address or check which buyers fit a deal.
Writes your offer
A cash offer by text or email in the tone you pick. It never goes above your max offer.
Handles pushback
Paste what the seller said and get replies that hold your number. You choose what to send.
Auto follow-up
Five friendly check-ins over 30 days (days 1, 3, 7, 14 and 30) by email, and by text through GoHighLevel for sellers who agreed to texts.
Stops on its own
When you call or text the seller, mark the lead dead, move it to deals or they unsubscribe.
Follows the rules
Emails include your business address and an unsubscribe link. Texts only go to sellers who gave consent.
